scenario: LDTL.4.1 — a per-emit `retain:` override applies only to a ttl-lifecycle schema (it overrides the schema TTL). On a non-ttl target (here a `logical` schema) it has nothing to override and is rejected with DS_VALIDATE_RETAIN_NON_TTL, even with +dynamic_ttl declared.
rules_ds:
use default:
    dynamic_ttl: true

schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
schema Out scope logical:
    k: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    emit Out logical k: t.k retain: 60_s
